lines.trans: This is not a shelter, but work!
Chef, you still won't let me cook.
I already peeled all labels from the bananas.
Fine, you want to cook — you will cook!
Attention, cooks of the restaurant!
Today our runt is cooking lunch for the staff.
This is a very important assignment.
If they don't like it, they will eat you.
Did you understand me?
Yes, Chef, I understood everything.
I dreamed so much of cooking in the kitchen.
Well, are you pleased?
I am very glad, Chef, just let me drink coffee.
Quickly change clothes, let's get to work!
